interview.question: Decide all eight tenant/billing GUIDs independently using redacted attributable references. Justify a single corporate tenant or the specific regulatory/business requirements that cannot be met there, with authoritative inventory and service/B2B, licensing, audit and JML considerations, not resource counts. For applicable multitenant platform automation, explain approved complete isolation or shared-application/per-tenant-principal boundaries, current user-assigned managed-identity federation qualifications, targeting, privilege/credential lifecycle, actual authorized operation, monitoring and recovery. Substantiate actual same-identity Lighthouse use and effective least-privilege delegated tasks separately from registration pairs. Lighthouse delegates subscriptions/RGs, not tenants/MGs or across clouds; Owner/custom/DataActions and specified authorization actions are unsupported, and UAA's constrained managed-identity assignment exception is not general access administration or full ALZ deployment authority. Explicitly establish partner/CSP applicability, customer approval, scope, audit/removal and agreement conditions; Entra GDAP/DAP, AOBO and resource delegation are different. Separately evidence the approved CSP case-creation/support/escalation process and dated operation without contacts, tickets or invented SLAs. Demonstrate actual suitable Cost Management reports/views, audiences, allocation and current data/access: view configuration is not underlying data, shared access, reporting or a pinned dashboard. Review actual EA charge policies or CSP Azure Plan/MCA/provider visibility and retail-versus-invoice limitations; MCA MG and EA/MCA cost-details MG limitations apply. Separately establish appropriate maintained agreement-specific notification group mailbox ownership, categories/cadence, delivery/review/escalation and continuity; EA notification contacts are not Bill to invoice contacts and MCA differs. Map actual approved organizational structure to EA departments/accounts or MCA profiles/invoice sections, or applicable CSP partner-managed MPA/customer structures; Azure MG hierarchy does not prove billing separation or authority. Never infer commercial model, tenant inventory, effective access, automation adoption or business suitability from names or metadata. Do not retain tenant/principal/contact/email identifiers, private partner records, raw billing names/IDs, prices, usage, query bodies or credentials.
